unscored.note: sizeMismatch: our render is a different SIZE than the original, so pixelmatch cannot run — counted in `pairs` (it is a failed pair) and never `perfect`, but NOT averaged: there is no measurement to average. noOriginal: no original screenshot exists, so there was never a pair — excluded from `pairs` entirely.

namedLosses: promotion: non-painting-part: part-0 <i> renders NO INK in any combo it appears in (content-visibility: hidden) and no descendant paints — NOT promoted. A part that paints nowhere must carry the fact that hides it (declared display:none / an opacity token) or be refused by name; neither `visibility` nor `content-visibility` has a carried spelling, so promoting this box would put a VISIBLE frame on the canvas that the browser draws nowhere (the general form of the SVG <title> defect)

promotion: pseudo-decor-geometry-multiaxis: tab::after drawn offsets vary across the enabled combos and do not factor as a function of ONE enum axis ({"top":30,"left":5.9998000000000005} vs {"top":4,"left":0} vs {"top":41,"left":11.9998} vs {"top":8,"left":0} vs {"top":51,"left":12.000099999999996} vs {"top":10,"left":0}) — the two-axis geometry product named in examples/tailwind/PROVENANCE.md; named refusal
